Privacy, in plain language.

ColorVerse is a color exploration project by byigit.dev. This page describes the current public site at colorverse.byigit.dev.

Your images stay with you

Image-to-palette and the RoomKit photo experiment process images in your browser. Choosing or pasting an image does not upload it to ColorVerse, Google Analytics, or a public gallery. The image preview lasts for the current session.

Storage that makes the tools work

Browser storage remembers your color tray, appearance, current palette, and cookie choice. These settings stay in this browser; clearing site data removes them. A palette kept in session storage lasts for that tab's session. Local storage is not a backup or cross-device account.

The privacy choice is stored as colorverse-consent for up to 180 days. You can change it at any time using Cookie settings in the footer. The color tools work without analytics.

Private projects and sign-in

If you choose to save a Studio project, Supabase processes your email address, authentication session, project name, five palette colors, role assignments, preview context, and version history. Projects are private to the signed-in account under database row-level security. ColorVerse uses a passwordless email link and stores the signed-in session in this browser.

Saving a project does not upload an image used for extraction or RoomKit. Public Community publishing is not available in the current MVP. Signing out ends the cloud session; clearing site data also removes the local session. See Supabase's privacy policy.

Optional Google Analytics

Only after you allow analytics do we load Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC). It helps us understand page visits and which tools are used. We do not send your uploaded images, project names, typed text, or account identifiers as analytics events.

Analytics can process technical information such as your browser, approximate location and IP address during transmission. Our page-view configuration excludes URL query parameters and fragments. Google may process data outside your country. See Google's privacy policy.

Analytics cookies use names beginning _ga and a configured lifespan of up to 90 days. Rejecting analytics prevents the Google tag from loading. Withdrawing consent disables tracking, removes this host's analytics cookies, and reloads the page to stop the tag.

Hosting and third-party resources

Cloudflare serves the site and can process request information such as IP addresses for delivery and security. Palette reference images and the primary interface font are served directly by ColorVerse; viewing the product does not request them from Unsplash or Google Fonts. Source links are retained for provenance and open only when you choose them. See Cloudflare's privacy policy and Unsplash's privacy policy.

Choices and contact

Use the footer to change analytics preferences. Use your browser's site-data controls to erase local palettes and preferences. For privacy questions, contact the project owner through byigit.dev. Do not send passwords or private reference images in a support request.
